effects.title: Frost
effects.subtitle: A softer close.
effects.detail: Your desktop stays in place as a soft blur deepens toward the upper edge. Inspired by the iPhone Duo transition.

effects.title: Veil
effects.subtitle: A quiet layer of glass.
effects.detail: A translucent native material settles over your desktop, with a soft neutral tint. No Screen Recording needed.

effects.title: Fade
effects.subtitle: Ease into the dark.
effects.detail: A smooth shade follows the lid toward a gentle blackout. No Screen Recording needed.

effects.title: Curtains
effects.subtitle: Every close deserves a curtain call.
effects.detail: Garnet velvet draws in from both sides. Sculpted folds catch the stage lights as the curtains meet, then gather away when you open the lid.

effects.title: Current
effects.subtitle: A little life in every opening.
effects.detail: Luminous mint and coral ribbons flow around a widening opening. Drifting sparks and soft waves keep the scene alive while your lid holds still. Reduce Motion stills the flow.

effects.title: Peekaboo
effects.subtitle: Your desktop has an audience.
effects.detail: Two glossy, mischievous shutters peek in from the edges. Their googly eyes look around and blink as the soft 3D faces breathe. Open the lid and they slide away. Reduce Motion stills the faces.

effects.title: Glass Fracture
effects.subtitle: A small impact. A thousand reflections.
effects.detail: An impact blossoms from the centre into irregular glass facets and spectral fracture lines. Close the lid to assemble the glass; open it to retrace the breakage. The glass is a procedural overlay that needs no Screen Recording permission.

effects.title: Ink Vortex
effects.subtitle: Let your desktop fall into a little magic.
effects.detail: A pool of midnight ink curls outward in turquoise and violet arms. Its rippling rim follows your lid until the whole display is immersed. Opening unwinds the spiral; Reduce Motion stills the ink.
